Same flex space-between text-width artifact as 可用余额: above. The balance-row right edge is aligned correctly; the value's left edge sits ~10px further right because PJS glyph widths are tighter than figma's HarmonyOS reference.

Right-side balance group uses flex space-between against figma master width 326. PJS-rendered amount glyph 10,000.00 USD is ~10px narrower than figma's reported width (75 vs 86), so the right group sits ~10-13px further right while its RIGHT edge stays aligned with the cell padding. Exchange-info cell row baseline ascent: figma TEXT y reports HarmonyOS Sans TC ink-box top inside its row; web Range.getBoundingClientRect on PJS reports the glyph ink-box top which sits ~11px lower due to PJS-Bold ascent line metrics vs HarmonyOS. Cell position correct (master y=324), row marginTop 18 = figma 342 line-frame top; residual delta = font-metric ascent difference.

Exchange info rate-value position: figma reports right-edge based on HarmonyOS glyph width (figma w=42). PJS renders ~3-5px narrower so the value left edge sits a few px right of figma. Right edge still anchored to the row's right boundary via space-between.
